import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/documents?view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_by_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bdocument_type%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bfile_type%5D=pdf&filters%5Bfile_type%5D=txt&filters%5Bis_in_recycle_bin%5D=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&filters%5Bsearch%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bfolder_id%5D=26&filters%5Bprivate%5D=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
